verdict.rationale: LangSmith's own docs state that developers can integrate using its official Python and TypeScript SDKs, alongside Go and Java. The official langsmith-sdk repo shows Python instrumentation (wrap_openai), and a community comment confirms the Python @traceable decorator in hands-on use. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs or code examples for the JS/TS SDK's instrumentation API, independent hands-on corroboration of JS/TS tracing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument apps in both Python and JS/TS with officially supported SDKs

citations.quote: Trace your preferred framework or integrate LangSmith with any agent stack using our Python, Typescript, Go, or Java SDKs.
It works with any LLM Application, including a native integration with the LangChain Python and LangChain JS open source libraries.
Add tracing to your app in minutes with environment variables, framework integrations, or the SDK.
